meta.name: 3d-modeling
meta.description: Expert 3D modeling specialist with deep knowledge of topology, UV mapping, game-ready and film-ready pipelines, DCC tool workflows (Blender, Maya, ZBrush, 3ds Max, Houdini), retopology, LOD systems, and export pipelines. This skill represents years of production experience distilled into actionable guidance. Use when "3d model, 3d modeling, mesh topology, uv unwrap, uv mapping, retopology, retopo, low poly, high poly, subdivision, subdiv, edge flow, edge loops, polygon modeling, box modeling, hard surface, organic modeling, sculpting, zbrush, blender modeling, maya modeling, 3ds max, LOD, level of detail, game ready mesh, film ready, baking normals, high to low, fbx export, gltf export, texel density, 3d, modeling, topology, uv, game-dev, vfx, blender, maya, zbrush, retopology, lod, hard-surface, organic, sculpting" mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和优化3D模型，掌握拓扑、UV映射与导出流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要专业指导来完成3D建模、拓扑或UV映射任务。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need expert guidance on 3D modeling, topology, or UV mapping.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 会以资深 3D 艺术家的身份回答建模问题，提供拓扑、UV 映射、游戏/影视管线、DCC 工具工作流、重拓扑、LOD 系统、导出等方面的专业指导。
howto.when: 当用户提到 3D 建模相关词汇（如“拓扑”、“UV 展开”、“重拓扑”、“低多边形”、“高多边形”、“Blender”、“Maya”等）时，Claude 会触发并接管回答。

say.text: 如何优化这个低多边形角色的拓扑？
say.note: Claude 会分析拓扑并提出改进建议。

say.text: 高模到低模的法线烘焙流程是什么？
say.note: Claude 会解释高到低多边形的烘焙步骤。

say.text: 在 Blender 中如何正确导出 FBX 到 Unity？
say.note: Claude 会给出跨 DCC 工作流的最佳实践。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will respond as a senior 3D artist, providing expert guidance on topology, UV mapping, game/film pipelines, DCC tool workflows, retopology, LOD systems, and export pipelines.
howto.when_en: Claude triggers when the user mentions 3D modeling related terms such as "topology", "UV unwrap", "retopology", "low poly", "high poly", "Blender", "Maya", etc.

say_en.text: How can I optimize the topology of this low-poly character?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze topology and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: What is the workflow for baking normals from high to low poly?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the high-to-low polygon baking process.

say_en.text: How to properly export FBX from Blender to Unity?
say_en.note: Claude will give best practices for cross-DCC workflows.
